div.div:
Workstream
orchestrator
triages the report,
traces the cause,
assigns the fix

Loop fix PR
in factory-loop (skills,
review workflow); same
CI + review gate

Nazar
approves and merges
the loop fix

v0 tag moves
repos on @v0 get
the workflow fix

next runs use
the fixed loop

The loop fixes itself.An agent that hits a problem in the loop (a skill, the reviewer, CI) reports it to the orchestrator. The fix ships as a PR to the loop's own repo. Workflow fixes reach every repo when the v0 tag moves; skill fixes ship as a plugin update. Nazar's only steps: approve and merge.
Example:factory-loop #16 and #14, review-job fixes raised by an agent from forge-cli PRs: a false red review check, and review runs that stopped early. Both were merged and rolled out via v0; after #14, the next review on forge-cli #42 passed.

div.div:
Stageis a field on the org Project board “Crucible Loop”; an item can also beparked.
Agents never push to main and never merge. Product releases (npm, brew, scoop) stay manual.
